title: Fandango Media reports data breach involving payment card information
summary: As outlined in Bleeping Computer, Fandango Media is notifying customers of a data breach that exposed sensitive payment card details entered on its checkout pages. The incident occurred between Oct. 8 and Oct. 11, 2026, affecting users who made purchases through the company's official website.
why_it_matters: Breaches and cybercrime activity signal where attackers are focusing and what data types are actively monetized.
recommendation: Validate incident-response readiness, monitor for exposed credentials, and reinforce MFA, phishing resistance, and data-loss controls.
